claude_fit.reason: Pancreatitis resolved, more than 72 hours since last drink with CIWA-Ar under 8 (MH-4 met), independent ADLs and mobility (ADL-1, MOB-3), AOx4 and self-administers oral meds (COG-1, COG-2), MRSA and COVID negative (INF-1, INF-2). The only issue is the form's 'Refusing detox' box, which the social work note contradicts (FORM-X5 met from the chart).
